name: Solid Försäkringsaktiebolag (publ)
summary: Solid Försäkringsaktiebolag (publ) specializes in providing non-life insurance coverage to private individuals across Sweden, Denmark, Norway, Finland, and broader European regions. Its business operations are segmented into three core divisions: Personal Safety, Product, and Assistance. The company's comprehensive product lineup includes protection for bicycles, consumer electronics, income, payment defaults, identity theft, and personal accidents. It also offers extensive travel and cancellation insurance, all-risk policies, various assistance services, and specialized insurance tied to vehicle warranties and the travel industry. Moreover, Solid provides deductible protection for appliances, garden tools, spectacles, watches, and jewelry. These offerings are distributed through a variety of channels, including retail chains, banking and credit institutions, travel agencies, and car dealerships, as well as directly to consumers. Founded in 1993, the firm's headquarters are located in Helsingborg, Sweden.
